definitions.explanation: A large entrance structure, typically at the entrance to a temple, shrine, castle, estate, or other significant building. Larger and more formal than a door (ドア) or a garden gate ({戸|と}).

examples.english: Pass through the gate of a temple.

examples.japanese: ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正門|せいもん}→正門：04350_seimon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{六時|ろくじ}→六時：10982_rokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The main gate of the castle opens at six in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}られた→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{門|もん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A large gate painted red stood imposingly at the entrance to the shrine.

notes:
USAGE:
{門|もん} refers to a substantial gate structure, typically at temples, shrines, castles, or traditional estates. It is not used for ordinary house doors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {門|もん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くぐる (to pass through a gate)
- {門|もん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to open a gate)
- {門|もん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧ (to close a gate)
- ⟦{正門|せいもん}→正門：04350_seimon⟧ (main gate)
- ⟦{裏門|うらもん}→裏門：18644_uramon⟧ (back gate)
- ⟦{校門|こうもん}→校門：13116_koumon⟧ (school gate)
- ⟦{山門|さんもん}→山門：12615_sanmon⟧ (temple gate)

WRITING:
{門|もん} is itself a radical ({門構|もんがま}え) that appears in many kanji related to openings, enclosures, or barriers: ⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧, ⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧, ⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧, {関|かん}, ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {門|もん}: gate (large, formal entrance structure)
- ⟦{戸|と}→戸：00676_to⟧: door, small gate (house entrance)
- ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧: door (Western-style hinged door)
- ⟦{鳥居|とりい}→鳥居：05956_torii⟧: torii gate (Shinto shrine gate)
